body.objective: Students will be able to talk about healthy habits.
body.iCan: I can talk about healthy habits.
successCriteria: I can talk about healthy habits and food
I can use 了 le to show completed actions
I can describe Chinese food culture and table customs
body.hook: In China, a common greeting isn't "How are you?" but 你吃了吗？Nǐ chī le ma? "Have you eaten?" Food is at the heart of Chinese culture, and the particle 了 le helps you talk about what you've done.

vocabulary.definition: Particle showing a completed action or a change.

study.title: 吃了吗？Chī le ma?
study.question: How do I talk about health, food and completed actions in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Healthy habits: 多吃蔬菜 duō chī shūcài (eat more vegetables), 多喝水 duō hē shuǐ (drink more water), 每天运动 měitiān yùndòng (exercise every day), 早睡早起 zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ (early to bed, early to rise), 少吃糖 shǎo chī táng (eat less sugar).
了 le for completed actions: verb + 了: 我吃了早饭。Wǒ chī le zǎofàn. = I ate breakfast. Negative uses 没 méi without 了: 我没吃早饭。Wǒ méi chī zǎofàn. = I didn't eat breakfast. Question: 你吃了吗？/ 你吃了没有？
Food culture: Dishes are shared from the centre of the table; each person has a bowl of rice. Use 筷子 kuàizi; never stick chopsticks upright in rice (it resembles incense at funerals). Hot tea is common with meals. Regional cuisines: 四川 Sìchuān (spicy), 广东 Guǎngdōng (dim sum), 北京 Běijīng (roast duck).
对话:
小明 Xiǎomíng：你吃了吗？Nǐ chī le ma?
莉莉 Lìlì：我吃了。我吃了米饭和蔬菜，还喝了茶。Wǒ chī le. Wǒ chī le mǐfàn hé shūcài, hái hē le chá.
小明：你很健康！我今天没吃早饭。Nǐ hěn jiànkāng! Wǒ jīntiān méi chī zǎofàn.
莉莉：不好！你应该每天吃早饭。Bù hǎo! Nǐ yīnggāi měitiān chī zǎofàn.
Task: Write what you ate and did yesterday using 了 and 没, then share table customs from your culture.

study.product: Write a food and health diary in Mandarin for two days (at least six sentences with 了 and two with 没), and present one Chinese table custom.

examples.title: 了
examples.answer: 我喝了水。Wǒ hē le shuǐ.

examples.title: Question
examples.answer: 你吃了吗？Nǐ chī le ma?

examples.title: Custom
examples.problem: Why not stick chopsticks upright in rice?
examples.answer: It looks like incense offered for the dead

practice.q: What does 健康 jiànkāng mean?
What does 蔬菜 shūcài mean?
What does 筷子 kuàizi mean?
What does 运动 yùndòng mean?
What does 你吃了吗 mean?

practice.a: 我吃了米饭。Wǒ chī le mǐfàn.
我没喝茶。Wǒ méi hē chá.
Rice and vegetables, and she drank tea.

practice.q: What does 早睡早起 mean?
practice.a: Early to bed, early to rise.

practice.q: Why is 了 not used with 没?
practice.a: 没 already shows the action didn't happen.

practice.q: Explain how dishes are shared at a Chinese meal.
practice.a: Dishes are in the centre; everyone takes from them with their own rice bowl.

practice.q: Translate: You should eat more vegetables.
practice.a: 你应该多吃蔬菜。Nǐ yīnggāi duō chī shūcài.

practice.q: What is the cultural meaning of 你吃了吗？
practice.a: A friendly greeting showing care, like "How are you?"

misconceptions: Using 不 instead of 没 for past actions
Thinking all Chinese food is the same
exitTicket: Write two sentences with 了 and one with 没.

items.q: Sichuan food is known for being

options: D) early to bed, early to rise
items.answer: D) early to bed, early to rise

items.q: Sticking chopsticks upright in rice is avoided because
In a negative past sentence, 了 is
At a Chinese meal, dishes are usually
Name two healthy habits in Mandarin.
Write three sentences about what you ate yesterday using 了.
What advice does Lìlì give Xiǎomíng?
items.answer: He should eat breakfast every day.

items.q: Explain how 了 and 没 work together.
items.answer: 了 shows completed actions; 没 negates the past without 了.

items.q: Compare Chinese table customs with your own.
